systemPrompt.title: System Prompt
systemPrompt.description: Add custom instructions for all agents or for a specific agent. Pick the scope below, then edit its prompt. It appears after Tide Commander base rules but before agent class instructions.
systemPrompt.noAgents: No agents yet. Spawn an agent first, then set its system prompt here.
systemPrompt.saved: System prompt saved. It applies to this agent's next session.
systemPrompt.savedGlobal: Global system prompt saved. It applies to every agent's next session.
systemPrompt.cleared: System prompt cleared for this agent.
systemPrompt.hint: This prompt is inserted into the system instructions for the selected agent only.
systemPrompt.hintGlobal: This prompt is inserted into the system instructions of every agent, before any per-agent prompt.
systemPrompt.placeholder:
Enter the system prompt here...

Examples:
- Coding style guidelines
- Team communication rules
- Project-wide conventions
- Security best practices
systemPrompt.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear this agent's system prompt?
systemPrompt.confirmClearGlobal: Are you sure you want to clear the global system prompt (all agents)?

whatsapp.description: Configure the local WhatsApp (Baileys) integration. The backend talks to a local server (default port 3007) using an API key.

whatsappNotifications.eventsHint: Each toggle controls one event type. When OFF, that event is skipped silently.
